title: The M5 13-inch MacBook Air is $149 off
content:
Macworld

Apple MacBook Air M5

View Deal

If you’ve been waiting for a good moment to grab a MacBook Air, this is the sale you want. The 13-inch M5 MacBook Air is down to $1,449 at Amazon right now, a savings of $150 off its usual $1,599. It’s not the best price we’ve ever seen, but it’s the lowest we’ve seen since Apple raised prices in June.

The best part about this laptop is that it’s fast. The M5 chip is the best you can get at this price point, and the 16GB of memory will make everything run smoothly. From launching apps in a blink to switching between them with ease, this laptop can help you handle your daily projects without issue. For anyone juggling work, school, and hobbies on a single device, the MacBook’s responsiveness will keep you going. The M5 chip is also perfectly capable of handling Apple Intelligence tasks, so you can use that to write, summarize, and generally get things done faster. Whether you want to polish up an email or some other task for work, this can do that easily.

Battery life is also stellar because you get a super slim laptop that can survive for 18 hours on a single charge. It will comfortably cover a full day of work or classes without having to panic if you forgot the charger, and that’s amazing.

Of course, the screen is amazing, too. The 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display is vibrant and fast, so photos and videos look rich and lifelike, while text stays razor-sharp. For all the video calls that fill a normal week, the 12MP Center Stage camera keeps you centered in frame automatically, which is amazing if you tend to move around a lot.

For $1,449, this is an easy pick if you want a fast, gorgeous, all-day laptop that plays perfectly with the rest of your Apple gear.
